question: What happens to knowledge when the worldly lineage is destroyed?
premises: The destruction of the worldly knowledge lineage occurs.
This knowledge takes the form of a different, noble lineage not accustomed to worldly life.
inference: When worldly conditioning is destroyed, knowledge shifts into a transcendent lineage.
plain_english: When that worldly lineage is destroyed, transcendent knowledge arises and takes on the character of another, noble lineage not accustomed to worldly life.
